decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 16 January 2006, subject to the full demolition of the existing single-storey rear extension to the rear of the two-storey rear projection, the erection of a single storey side/rear extension measuring 6.5m deep, 3.3m high and 1.9m wide, and the erection of a 5.2m wide, 2.2m high, 3.9m deep rear roof extension to the main roof would be lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:
1 - The single-storey extension development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposal satisfied the relevant criteria in the Order. 
2 - The rear roof extension falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes B and C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the proposal satisfied the relevant criteria in the Order.

Condition : 2 - Prior to the commencement of any building works, the original single storey rear extension to the rear of the property shall be demolished to ground level. Only once this structure is removed should the extensions hereby deemed lawful be commenced. This is in the interests of ensuring that the resulting development does not exceed the maximum volume permitted by the Town & Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the demolition of existing rear extension and subsequent erection of single storey side/rear extension and erection of roof extension to house
